description.value: Dosa Crepe Café is a South Indian restaurant on Bernard Avenue in Downtown Kelowna specializing in dosa — gluten-free, vegan crepes made from fermented rice and black gram batter — blended with French crepe influences. Beyond dosa, the menu spans biriyani, curries, kothu roti, bubble tea, and licensed beverages, giving hungry cyclists a broad range of options. It is the flagship of a growing BC chain with branches in Rutland, Vernon, and Osoyoos.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content confirms the Downtown Kelowna location at 523 Bernard Ave, Kelowna, BC, V1Y 6N9 with phone 778 484 6551, matching OSM tags. The menu and about pages explicitly state dosa is 'gluten free, vegan,' and the locations page confirms 'Dine-in & Take-Away' and pickup/delivery service. No bike parking, washroom, or water refill evidence appears in either the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: Downtown Kelowna branch email is inconsistent across pages: 'orderdosa2@gmail.com' on the front page and About page, but 'orderdosacrepe@gmail.com' on the Locations and Contacts pages.
Franchise page copy contains the phrase 'sizzling burgers' — clearly a copy-paste artefact from an unrelated template, suggesting the website was built from a generic franchise template.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate dine-in/takeout restaurant on Kelowna's main tourist corridor offering vegan and gluten-free options — a solid food stop for touring cyclists passing through Downtown Kelowna.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website explicitly states 'Our Dosa is gluten free, vegan.' Menu includes numerous plant-based dosa, vegetable, and lentil-based dishes

wow_evidence: flagship of a growing BC chain with branches in Rutland, Vernon, and Osoyoos
